ValidationRule.description: To prevent users to convert leads to opps if the meeting purpose is BDR Meeting and there is not a value of Meeting Outcome - Meeting Held Opp created
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
IsConverted
&&
RecordType.Name = "Default"
&&
ISBLANK(TEXT( BDR_Meeting_Held_Opp_Created__c ))
&&
ISPICKVAL( BDR_meeting_on_event__c , "Yes")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This lead has a BDR meeting set for it. Update the task field "Meeting Outcome" to "Meeting Held - Opp Created"
